notes.title: SCREAM FEST: 70% DISCOUNT AND THE DEMO IS LIVE AGAIN!
notes.content:
Guild of Darksteel is participating in the Steam Scream Fest, which starts today and runs until 1st November! 

We're making the demo live again for the duration of the event, and we're also giving the game a massive 70% discount, which is its deepest discount yet, so you can discover the dark fantasy world of Ravenrock for an absolute steal. 

Good luck to all new sellswords!

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356580/Guild_of_Darksteel/

notes.title: RELEASE DATE CONFIRMED – GUILD OF DARKSTEEL IS LAUNCHING SOON!
notes.content:
Greetings sellswords! I'm delighted to share the news that Guild of Darksteel has an official release date – the game will launch July 15th on Steam (and Nintendo Switch)! It will be available for a limited time with a 25% launch discount, so – if you haven't already – add it to your wishlist and you'll be alerted the moment it's available.

[previewyoutube=NBcJz5xXhUA;full][/previewyoutube]
Thanks for your support!

Matt | Digerati
